# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph's Rule; The End of the Story

---

**1** Joseph was wise and insightful in everything he did, and he prospered in all of it — because the Lord God was with him.

**2** Joseph governed Egypt for eighty years. Under his rule Egypt was at peace and flourished, because Joseph administered its affairs wisely.

**3** Joseph's name became great throughout the land, and his fame reached the ends of the earth.

**4** The Israelites multiplied greatly in Egypt and grew mighty and very numerous.

**5** Joseph loved Aseneth all his life, and she was his only wife.

**6** Aseneth was honored in Joseph's house and throughout Egypt. She was called the mother of all who take refuge in the Lord God Most High.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
